_readme: Human corrections applied ON TOP of the Command Center mirror by
agents/scout-vault.mjs. Use this when you know something the vault does not
yet — a payment that landed this morning, a client with no note.
Every field patched here reads as 'reported by <reportedBy>' on the screen,
never as a mirror figure, so provenance stays honest.
THIS FILE IS TEMPORARY BY DESIGN. It patches a stale note; it does not fix
one. Update the vault, confirm the mirror carries it through, then delete
this file. The Scout warns once these corrections are more than a week old,
because an override nobody retires becomes a second source of truth — the
exact thing this system is built to avoid.
Nothing here may contain anything that is not already fit to be public:
this repo is a public mirror. See 'What never goes in this repo' in

OPEN CONFLICT 2026-08-16, affects revenue.outstanding: the Robert Davis P.A. payment log in Notion records $1,500 received and $500 still owed on a $2,000 Phase 1. The client-facing outreach draft dated 2026-07-26 on the same account asks for 'the remaining $1,000 balance'. Both cannot be true. The $0 here assumes the payment log is right and the August $500 cleared it. If the draft is right, outstanding is $500. Resolve it in the vault, then retire this override.
